_comment: Single source of truth for coded values. Codes are ASCII-safe; display labels live in js/translations/*.js (enum.<category>.<id>); Arabic terms live here and are never translated. Classifications are independent attributes, not one mutually-exclusive 'type'.

root_category.description: Quadriliteral root (four radicals), including reduplicated ones such as ز ل ز ل. It is a root in its own right: it is never reduced to a related triliteral root. Further categories (for example a five-radical one) are added here, with their radicals count, without any code change.

origin.description: Taken from a registered, cleared external source; carries source_id, source_version and source_ref.
Authored or decided by QURRA editors (not from an external dataset). Never implies review.
A QURRA root assignment made under the Root Verification Protocol (only once the protocol is frozen).
Checked by a qualified reviewer. Only valid together with status reviewed/verified and a review block.

clearance.description: Licence chain established; may be bundled, with its recorded attribution.
Permission exists but depends on conditions or confirmation that are not yet resolved; never bundled.
Licence or upstream provenance not established; never bundled.
Known to forbid or not to permit the intended use; never bundled.

lemma_scope.description: The analysis assigns the lemma to the specific stem segment (QURRA's native shape).
The analysis asserted one lemma for the whole token; it is attached to the form's single stem. Only valid for forms with exactly one stem.

root_letters._comment: Allowed canonical root letters (QURRA canonical spelling): no diacritics, hamza only as ء, weak radicals only و / ي. The ASCII slug table is QURRA's own (not copied from any corpus); root ids are 'root-' + slugs joined by '-'.

status.description: Verbatim from a registered source; not edited by QURRA.
Work in progress; never shown to learners.
Usable for the prototype but not reviewed; shown only with a visible label.
A qualified reviewer checked the evidence and the rule application.
Reviewed plus second-reviewer or audit confirmation under the frozen protocol.
Documented scholarly disagreement; no value is asserted.
Insufficient evidence or a pending decision; no value is asserted.
Intentionally empty by policy (for example, closed-class words carry no root).

display_policy._comment: What a learner sees per layer and status. show = plain (provisional glosses and morphology rely on the page-level prototype banner and the Source information panel); show_with_badge = shown with an inline 'provisional' label (roots, conjugation); under_review = the field is replaced by an 'under review' note; not_applicable = replaced by a neutral 'none for this kind of word' note; hide = nothing. Change a value here and rebuild to change the whole app.

review_gate._comment: Encodes the structural part of the root production gate. A root assignment with one of these statuses must carry evidence and a reviewer; one with a 'must_be_null' status must not carry a root value.
